$comment: The organisers' format for one design (Project CHAMELEON starter). tools/checks.py validates every engine output against this file. $comment notes are ours; validators ignore them.
title: CHAMELEON Design Document (v0.9, provisional, pending Peter's sign-off)
description: One design: a canvas plus its list of elements. The engine receives the source design in this shape and returns the resized design in the same shape, with new values.

element.$comment: Every element has id, type and geometry. The other fields depend on type; allOf at the bottom lists what each type requires.

id.description: Stable identifier. The engine returns every input id exactly once. It can't add, remove or invent elements.

x.description: Left edge in px, measured from the canvas's top-left corner.

rotation.description: Degrees, clockwise, around the element's center.

opacity.$comment: The official renderer ignores opacity on text elements, so hiding text this way doesn't work.

z_index.description: Stacking order. Higher paints on top.

group_id.$comment: Our engine treats a group as one block and keeps its pieces together.
group_id.description: Elements that share a group_id are one unit the designer meant to keep together, for example a button's background shape and its label. The engine isn't told what the group means, only that the pieces travel together.

content.description: Text only. The literal string to draw.

font_size.description: Text only, in px. The engine may change it so the text fits its box.

color.description: Text and shape. CSS-style rgba(), for example rgba(255,255,255,1).

line_height.description: Text only. A multiplier of the font size.

max_lines.description: Text only, optional. A cap on the number of lines. The renderer wraps within the box either way.

style_runs.description: Text only, optional. Per-character overrides, for example a two-colour headline. Indices point into content, start at 0, and end is exclusive.

asset_id.description: Image only. Names a file in brand_kit/assets. The engine never invents pixels: it only moves and resizes this asset.

fit.$comment: cover fills the box and crops the overflow, contain fits inside it, fill stretches to it.
fit.description: Image only. How the picture fills its box.
